title: METHODS FOR TEACHING HEALTH, WELLNESS, AND FINE ARTS
description: Explores recent trends and research-based practices in the teaching of health, wellness, and fine arts. Includes strategies, assessments, special needs, integrating curriculum through developmentally appropriate practices, content standards, and the value of developing holistic learners through an effective health, wellness, and fine arts program.
